title: Bride-to-Be Taylor Swift Stuns in White at Star-Studded Premiere - NewsBreak
text:
By Tania Calderón ,
12 hours ago Taylor Swift made a rare red carpet appearance in Los Angeles. One small accessory quickly became a talking point. Taylor Swift made an unexpected return to the red carpet on Tuesday night, stepping out in Los Angeles for the world premiere of Toy Story 5. The singer arrived at the Dolby Theatre in a playful off-the-shoulder mini dress by Erdem, pairing the look with gold open-toe heels, red lipstick and a half-up hairstyle. According to Hello!, the appearance came as a welcome moment for fans who had not expected to see her at the film’s launch. She also posed with cast members including Tom Hanks, Tim Allen and Conan O'Brien. Read full article
